description: This file defines the AWS SDK client for interacting with the Amazon Kinesis Analytics V2 service. It extends the base AwsClient class and provides method signatures for various actions such as creating, updating, and deleting applications, along with async variants.

classes.name: KinesisAnalyticsV2Client
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Kinesis Analytics V2 API, providing methods for managing applications and related resources.

methods.name: addApplicationCloudWatchLoggingOption
methods.description: Adds a CloudWatch logging option to the Kinesis Analytics application.

methods.name: addApplicationInput
methods.description: Adds an input configuration to the application.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new Kinesis Analytics application.
